venue.name: Zeballos Heritage Museum
venue.description: Zeballos Heritage Museum is one of the Village of Zeballos community facilities, at 122 Maquinna Ave in Zeballos on the north west coast of Vancouver Island. The village lists it as open by appointment and asks visitors to call the village office at 250-761-4229 to arrange a time. The museum is also listed with its own phone number, (250) 761-4070, and the address reception@zeballos.com. A village volunteer notice asks for people to help support the local library and museum, and says the museum's volunteer help is needed on an as needed when needed basis.

programs.name: Museum visit by appointment
programs.description: The village's community facilities page lists the museum as open by appointment and gives one instruction, to call 250-761-4229. The museum's own number, (250) 761-4070, and reception@zeballos.com are listed beside it. Nothing about admission, how long a visit lasts, what is on display, group sizes or an age range is published anywhere on the village site.
programs.our_note: Nothing is published about this museum beyond an address and a number to call, so the village office is where the real information is. Ask what a group of children would actually see and how long they need. Zeballos sits 42 km up an unpaved forest service road off Highway 19, about an hour from the turnoff, so it is a day built around the drive rather than a quick stop.
programs.practical_summary: An address and a phone number to arrange a visit are all the village publishes. Washrooms, somewhere to eat, a price, a minimum age and whether children's groups are taken at all are not stated, so every practical question has to go into that phone call.

gaps: the museum has no page of its own; everything published about it is one card on the Village of Zeballos community facilities page, giving an address, two phone numbers, an email address and the words open by appointment
no admission price of any kind is published, for adults, children or groups, and the site does not say whether a visit is free or by donation
no youngest age, age range or grade range is stated
the site does not say whether school or daycare groups are taken at all, so both of those are left unanswered rather than assumed
no capacity limit or group size is stated
no lead time is given; the site says only to call the village office to arrange a time
which months the museum is open is unknown, and so are the days and hours; open by appointment is all the site says
how long a visit takes is not stated
what is on display is not described anywhere on the site, so there is no account of what children would see or do
no indoor or outdoor lunch space for a group is mentioned
no rain backup is described, and the site does not say whether any part of the visit is outdoors
stroller and wheelchair access are not mentioned, and neither is parking for a bus

two phone numbers appear on the one card: the museum is listed at (250) 761-4070 while the line about opening says to call 250-761-4229, which is the village office number. The appointment number is recorded. This is not a disagreement between pages, so it is not filed as one

the museum photo on the community facilities page carries no alt text. The alt recorded here was written by us from the photo's position in the museum's card and its file name, Zeballos-Museum.jpg. No browser was available in this run, so the photo itself was not viewed

the village's employment page asks for volunteers to help support the library and museum and says the museum's volunteer help is on an as needed when needed basis, which suggests the museum is opened by volunteers rather than staffed to fixed hours
